title: Integration cadence sync brief — Calyx + Mosaic prelaunch
content:
Attendees: Priya (owner), Ethan (SRE follow), Laila (field eng), Marcus (integration PM), Zoe (QA lead)

Purpose: quick sync to align on pre-launch checklist for Calyx (payments vertical) and Mosaic (docs automation). Focus areas: smoke tests, fallback routing, billing telemetry, and final handoff to Dedicated ops.

Summary of current state
- Calyx: model pinned to rwinf/llama-v3-16k-q4f (quantized) for latency target. End-to-end smoke test passed in dev cluster but intermittent timeouts observed at 95th pct under 80-concurrent session load. Trace points show KV cache GC stalls on host pool b.
- Mosaic: embeddings + reranker pipeline stable; embedding vector size mismatch found in staging (legacy client sending 1536 vs expected 3072). Patch merged in client lib; regression test in CI pending.

Blockers / Risks
- KV cache GC stalls (Calyx): SRE investigating kernel scheduler knob; mitigation plan: reduce concurrent batch size to 32 and enable aggressive prefetch for 24h. If unresolved, plan fallback to smaller model variant for SLAs. Owner: Ethan. ETA: 2027-03-05.
- Embedding mismatch (Mosaic): client rollout required from customer; risk of delayed rollout if customer SDK cycle > 2 days. Owner: Laila to coordinate. Action: send step-by-step upgrade guide + compatibility shim.
- Billing telemetry gap: missing token-usage events for Mosaic reranker route in prod mirror — affects customer allocation and quota. Owner: Marcus. ETA: 2027-03-04.

Decisions made
- Canary window for Calyx will be 48 hours starting after KV fix verification; auto-fallback policy will prefer region-us-west-2 variant if latency > 200ms for two consecutive 5-min windows.
- For Mosaic, rollout of client update will include a temporary server-side translator for secondaries to accept old vector size for 72 hours.

Action items (next 72h)
- Ethan: complete kernel knob experiment logs + attach perf traces (ENG-1298). Due 2027-03-05.
- Zoe: run expanded smoke suite (synthetic sessions + long-history context) for Calyx and post results to Confluence; include token-level lat breakdown. Due 2027-03-04.
- Laila: schedule customer call with Mosaic engineering and send upgrade guide + shim example. Due 2027-03-03 (ASAP).
- Marcus: patch billing telemetry; add metric and alert for missing token events. Due 2027-03-04.
- Priya: prepare handoff doc to Dedicated ops (network & capacity specs, SLA targets, rollback playbook). Due 2027-03-06.

Notes / loose thoughts
- Consider enabling small-cache hot-path for frequently requested prefixes — rough perf win but risk of memory pressure. Add to backlog if KV fix holds.
- If customer SDK adoption window slips, propose temporary rate-limiting per-customer to keep overall cluster healthy.

Next sync: brief check-in 2027-03-05 (15 mins) — focus: Ethan perf outcome, Mosaic customer readiness, telemetry green.

Quick retro from this meeting format: concise, focused on blockers; include one page runbook snapshot next time to speed handoff.

References: see linked_artifacts above and Confluence runbook for detailed rollout steps.

Notes-to-self: convert smoking test artifacts into a reproducible k8s job that can be re-run by customer success; ticket -> ENG-1305 for automation.
